issues.text: 3 runs connect to the control's data bus. No more than 2 runs may connect directly (the screw terminals and the J1 and J2 connectors all count).
No device currents entered, so the power load was not checked. The +12V keypad output of the control is protected at 1.25 A; the hub adds 30 mA, plus 20 mA per branch for the M1DBHR.

checklist.title: Control
items: JP3 (terminating jumper on the M1 control): REMOVE it. With two runs, the far end of each run is terminated instead.
The data bus must have exactly two terminating points in total, never more.

checklist.title: Run 1
items: Daisy chain: control → Keypad (address 1). About 10 ft.
Terminate the last device only: Keypad (address 1). Fit its terminating jumper. Do not terminate the others.

checklist.title: Run 2
items: Daisy chain: control → Keypad (address 2). About 10 ft.
Terminate the last device only: Keypad (address 2). Fit its terminating jumper. Do not terminate the others.

checklist.title: Run 3
items: Daisy chain: control → Keypad (address 3). About 10 ft.
Terminate the last device only: Keypad (address 3). Fit its terminating jumper. Do not terminate the others.

checklist.title: Addresses to set
items: After setting the addresses, run Bus Module Enrollment (installer programming, or Live > Modules in this editor). Devices added later must be enrolled too.
